title: Your Job Is Hiding $3,840 From You Right Now
hook: Your employer set aside thousands of dollars with your name on it — and you've never claimed a dollar of it.
angle: Benefits content always focuses on 401k and health insurance. The hidden stack of untapped perks (FSA, tuition reimbursement, HSA match, wellness stipends) is worth nearly $4K/year and almost nobody uses it.
audience: Full-time employees aged 25-45 who picked benefits during open enrollment without really understanding what they signed up for
key_numbers: 42% of workers don't fully understand their benefits package
Dependent Care FSA saves families up to $2,000/year in taxes
Tuition reimbursement: $5,250/year — only 2% of eligible workers claim it
Average employer HSA contribution: $878/year that most workers leave uninvested
